prayerExcerpt.en-US: Even when we cannot give, words of kindness are as a precious balm.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Mesmo quando não podemos dar, as palavras de bondade são como um bálsamo precioso.

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman of senatorial family, about sixty-five, with a pale, olive-tinged complexion and a LONG, OVAL face with HEAVY, HOODED eyelids that give the eyes a half-closed, gentle look — a broad, FLAT, low nose bridge widening to a broad nose, soft, sloping cheeks, a FULL, projecting LOWER LIP, a rounded, fleshy chin; thinning grey hair combed forward; a SHORT, close-trimmed grey beard following the jaw; the gaze mild and generous, down toward the poor woman.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; the engraving on Wikipedia shows a mitred bishop in later dress. Wikipedia: of a senatorial family of the Auvergne, he built the basilica over St. Martin's tomb (consecrated 470–473) and left his wealth to the poor; the book gives his will, the poor as his heirs and the gold cross with relics for his sister Fidia Julia Perpetua. The heavy-lidded oval face with the full lower lip is our choice.
